An '''infrared scope''' was a type of [[Scope/Legends|scope]] that could be fitted to [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] included an infrared scope amongst its accessories.<ref name="SWS" /> The [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] of a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] included infrared scopes.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|Seeker]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could be equipped with [[heat detector]]s fitted with infrared scopes.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
